error: NullPointerException in transform step
root_cause: Upstream source table loaded 0 rows due to failed CDC job
resolution: Restart CDC job, rerun pipeline with --full-refresh flag
fix_sql: CALL restart_cdc_job('raw_sales'); -- then trigger DAG

error: Schema mismatch: column 'loyalty_tier' not found
root_cause: Source team added column without notifying downstream
resolution: Add column to staging table, update dbt model, rerun
fix_sql: ALTER TABLE staging.customers ADD COLUMN loyalty_tier VARCHAR(20);

error: SLA breach: job exceeded 6-hour window
root_cause: Full table scan due to missing index on product_id
resolution: Add index, partition table by warehouse_id, rerun
fix_sql: CREATE INDEX idx_product_id ON inventory(product_id);

error: Duplicate rows detected: 14,203 dupes in transactions table
root_cause: Idempotency key missing — pipeline ran twice due to scheduler retry
resolution: Deduplicate table, add idempotency key, fix scheduler config
fix_sql: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM transactions GROUP BY txn_hash);

error: Division by zero in revenue_per_click calculation
root_cause: Clicks column contains zero values for new campaign type
resolution: Add NULLIF guard in SQL, redeploy dbt model
fix_sql: SELECT revenue / NULLIF(clicks, 0) AS revenue_per_click FROM attribution;

error: Timeout after 3600s in join step
root_cause: Cartesian join due to missing join condition on currency_code
resolution: Add explicit join condition, add query timeout guardrail
fix_sql: SELECT * FROM payments p JOIN fx_rates f ON p.currency = f.currency AND p.date = f.rate_date;

error: Model scoring job failed: feature store returned NaN for 23% of users
root_cause: Feature computation window misaligned with lookback period
resolution: Fix lookback window, add NaN guard in scoring, rerun
fix_sql: UPDATE feature_store SET recency_score = 0 WHERE recency_score IS NULL;

error: PII detected in output table after anonymisation step
root_cause: New email_alias column was not added to anonymisation config
resolution: Add column to config, re-run anonymisation, audit output
fix_sql: UPDATE users_anonymised SET email_alias = MD5(email_alias) WHERE email_alias NOT LIKE '%@anon%';

error: Kafka consumer lag exceeded 2M messages
root_cause: Single-partition topic bottleneck — consumer not parallelised
resolution: Increase partitions, scale consumer group, monitor lag
fix_sql: -- Kafka: bin/kafka-topics.sh --alter --topic events --partitions 12

error: Referential integrity violation: 4,102 orphaned records
root_cause: Foreign key constraint dropped during migration not restored
resolution: Restore FK constraint, identify and quarantine orphaned records
fix_sql: ALTER TABLE journal_entries ADD CONSTRAINT fk_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id);

error: Unicode decode error on 3 records
root_cause: Source system sending Latin-1 encoded strings in UTF-8 column
resolution: Add encoding detection, cast problematic records
fix_sql: UPDATE products SET name = convert(name USING utf8mb4) WHERE HEX(name) LIKE '%E9%';

error: Missing data for 2024-12-25: 0 rows loaded
root_cause: Source API returned 204 No Content on holiday — loader did not distinguish from error
resolution: Add 204 handling, backfill with zero-row sentinel
fix_sql: INSERT INTO ad_spend (date, impressions, spend) VALUES ('2024-12-25', 0, 0.0);

error: Incorrect headcount: 47 terminated employees still counted as active
root_cause: Termination feed delayed by 3 days — pipeline reads stale HR snapshot
resolution: Switch to real-time HR API, add termination date filter
fix_sql: DELETE FROM active_employees WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM terminations WHERE effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE);

error: Memory error: 32GB limit exceeded in session grouping step
root_cause: Unbounded window function over 90-day lookback without partition
resolution: Add PARTITION BY user_id, limit window to 7 days
fix_sql: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS session_rank

error: Matching rate dropped from 94% to 61%
root_cause: Supplier changed invoice number format from INT to alphanumeric
resolution: Update matching logic to cast invoice_number as VARCHAR
fix_sql: WHERE CAST(a.invoice_number AS VARCHAR) = CAST(b.invoice_number AS VARCHAR)

error: Sentiment scores all returned NULL
root_cause: LLM API key rotated but not updated in pipeline config
resolution: Update API key in secrets manager, restart pipeline
fix_sql: -- No SQL fix; update secret: aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id llm-api-key

error: Forecast values 40% lower than expected for Q4
root_cause: Holiday seasonality features not included in retraining run
resolution: Retrain with seasonality features, validate on holdout, redeploy
fix_sql: -- Python: model.fit(X_train[seasonality_features], y_train)

error: Small files problem: 480,000 files < 1MB in S3 prefix
root_cause: Streaming writer not merging — merge interval set to 0
resolution: Set merge interval to 300s, run compaction job
fix_sql: -- Spark: spark.conf.set('spark.sql.files.maxRecordsPerFile', 1000000)

error: Cold start: no recommendations for 8,200 new users
root_cause: Collaborative filter requires 5+ interactions; new users have 0
resolution: Add fallback to popularity-based model for new users
fix_sql: -- Python: recommendations = popularity_model.predict(user_id) if interaction_count < 5 else cf_model.predict(user_id)

error: Audit records missing for 6-hour window on 2025-03-14
root_cause: Log shipper crashed silently; no alerting on log gap
resolution: Restore from backup log, add gap detection alert
fix_sql: INSERT INTO audit_trail SELECT * FROM audit_backup WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2025-03-14 02:00' AND '2025-03-14 08:00';
